The '''Cow Decal''' is a [[furniture]] item that hangs on a wall. It can be obtained from the [[Mayor's Manor#Prize Machine|prize machine]] in the [[Mayor's Manor]] as the 17th prize. After obtaining it from the prize machine, additional Cow Decals can be purchased from [[Marnie's Ranch]] for {{Price|10000}}.

==History==
{{History|1.6|Introduced.}}
